title: LunaFollowerSE - Character Bios
tagline: Hand-written SkyrimNet bios for 1 NPC from LunaFollowerSE.
description:
Official SkyrimNet character bios for NPCs added by LunaFollowerSE (LunaFollowerSE.esp).

Install this if LunaFollowerSE.esp is in your load order. NPCs without a static bio still get one generated automatically from their game data; this pack replaces that with the community-curated version.

Bios are the work of the SkyrimNet community.
author: skyrimnet
